body: Current GCC comparative evidence: double recurrence native FAST median runtime **314.12ms** versus GCC O0 **235.99ms**, O2 **95.94ms**. Median matched O2/Buster ratio0.3054: GCC **3.27x faster**, wins12/12 with disjoint observed ranges. Code sections **236 vs112 vs83B** (Buster/G0/G2), Buster **2.84x O2 text**. Disassembly: GCC keeps x and the two constants in XMM0/1/2 through the loop; Buster moves each arithmetic result GPR<->XMM and stores/reloads loop/phi homes, with constants materialized inside the loop. FP bank residency, hoisting and edge-spill suppression compose; no experiment attributes the entire3.27x to one of them or promises a recovery percentage. Preserve NaN/signed zero, call clobbers, mixed ABI/debug/edge cases while extending the existing allocator; no competing branch claim. Evidence: Buster d4ca72fb4e97ae0a410b0d03258b00495fa45e13, trusted Clang21.1.8 Release; Ubuntu GCC15.2.0-16ubuntu1; hosted EPYC7763. Corrected [run37005475203](https://github.com/buster14a/buster/actions/runs/37005475203), diagnostic branch e19b531e03db62afd8f688ecd69d7f9f111283bf, artifact SHA256 `47c04b2c3f12e26c1346c4dbde0face10643dbc7a0256e364495a5686fec94ec` independently verified. Explicit baseline ISA, non-PIC/non-PIE, same GNU11/wrapv/alias/char semantics, common GCC CRT/linker,12 matched rounds/all six orders, all output/hash oracles passed. Stock GCC distro hardening retained; no isolated hardening/pass ablation. This is diagnostic, not Zen5/native-retirement acceptance. Full45-dimension report: [#2274](https://github.com/buster14a/buster/issues/2274#issuecomment-5952384555). License: Buster first-party license unselected (#621); GCC GPL-3.0-or-later with component-specific runtime terms. No external compiler source copied.
